reason: Rewrite f_n(m/n) as a weighted sum of fractional parts. The fractional parts form a multiset with d copies of each j/b and d zeros, where d = gcd(m,n). Rearrangement bounds the sum by the sorted fractional parts, which yields an upper bound strictly below H_n - 1 when d > 1, and still strictly below H_n - 1 when d = 1 because the original order is not the reverse-sorted one unless m = n - 1.
